info.title: kuki F1 controlled staging customer Booking API
info.description: Implementation snapshot of the opt-in customer adapters on main e38443c6. Not a public/guest API or production contract. Only synthetic data. Context/sign-in is tracked separately in #309; quote, public URL and customer reschedule are not available here. Describes handler responses after HTTP parsing, not generic Fastify parser/size errors or disabled routing.

get.description: Requires current bearer-bound staging customer and offers permission. Active grant-bound placements only. Base price is not a final quote. No query parameters.
Read-only provisional slots in selected location's local date. Active grant required. No slot reservation or guarantee of confirmation; server rechecks during create.
Checks current customer/create permission. Does not reserve a slot or guarantee live grant.

post.description: Requires verified opaque session with linked Customer and current create permission. New command requires live grant; exact authorized committed retry may recover after grant revocation. Server computes price and availability. No customer ID, price or query parameters.

get.description: Positive-only recovery of original committed response for exact current Customer and key. No live grant required; current permission required. 404 is not evidence that an in-flight mutation failed. No query parameters; key only in header.

Current customer history permission required; readable after grant expiry. Prices and visit times are persisted snapshots; names are current labels. Up to 200 newest records, hasMore indicates truncation, no pagination contract yet.
Current customer cancellation permission; returns explicitly configured staging cutoff, not an owner-editable business policy. No query parameters.

post.description: Time cutoff and current customer/booking ownership verified in server transaction. No client-selected policy or customer ID. Requires empty JSON object and idempotency header. Does not require active publication grant.

get.description: Current customer reschedule permission and separately configured private staging cutoff. No tenant-owned policy, no query parameters.

post.description: Time-only move, exact Customer ownership, server UTC cutoff and current session checked transactionally. Preserves booking ID, Service/Staff/Location and price snapshot. Requires explicit opt-in, original idempotency key on retry; no active publication grant needed.

stagingBearer.description: Verified, tenant-bound opaque customer session; token shape alone is not authority.
